verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents an official MCP server that lets AI tools perform CRM operations, including bulk operations, and REST/bulk-write APIs that can update records, so an agent can write deal fields such as Stage. Nothing in the evidence shows the product surfacing email or meeting signals to drive those updates. missing for 10: evidence of email/meeting signal ingestion or access via API/MCP, explicit deal-stage/next-step update examples via MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: This allows you to perform CRM operations directly from your AI tool using natural language, without navigating the CRM interface or working with APIs.
Perform bulk operations on multiple records at once
This API allows you to insert, update, or upsert a maximum of 25000 records in a single API call.
Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
